// record 0057: 'a ** b' over a signed whole number. C++ has no operator
// for it. A negative exponent is 1/(a ** -b) truncated toward zero, which
// is 0 for every base but 1 and -1
static int64_t __power_i(int64_t base, int64_t exponent) {
    if (exponent < 0) {
        if (base == 1) {

    return answer;
}

// The two differ exactly when the signs differ and the division is not exact
